forge-test.Description: Give the FTK2.Forge upgrade orb + a disposable test blade to party slot 1, for orb-consumption testing.

warbrain-arena.Description: Spawn a small mixed encounter (melee + caster + support) to exercise WarBrain's tactical scoring across ability categories.

summoner-farm.Description: Repeatedly spawn and win a trivial encounter, to farm the FTK2.Summoner kill counter for evolution-threshold testing.

parity-check.Description: Print every currently-registered mod's ParityService registration (guid, version, dataHash, enabledFeatures) and the most recent mismatch result, for MP desync triage.
